William and Jane Morris Church Conservation Grants
records.justification: The agent's text only captures three eligibility claims from the reference text, omitting the majority of the eligibility and purpose criteria.

claims.text: Applications must be on behalf of a church, chapel, or other place of worship in the United Kingdom.
Funds are available for the conservation of decorative or non-structural interior features.
Eligible features include stained glass, sculpture, furniture, monuments/tombs, and wall paintings.
The object to be conserved must have been made no later than 1896.
No references are required for the application.
A professional architect or established conservator must direct the work.
Turret clocks and organs are generally not grant-aided.
Applications for clock or organ cases of significant contribution or antiquarian interest may exceptionally be considered.
Applications must be from the project director or principal investigator.
Awards will not be made for work contributing to an undergraduate or postgraduate degree.
Retrospective applications will not be considered.
